storage_contract: Existing strict Document nodes, version-bound ORG IDs. CivicDocumentVersion companion holds validated source JSON/hash, READY ingestion receipt and exact chunk hashes. CivicDocumentJournal retains staged phases and explicit status corrections. No registry/0001/0002 modification.
recovery: Additive; wait OPERATIONAL; checksum ledger; explicit retry failed constraints. Never drop graph/volume. NonREADY stages cannot be retrieved; retry verifies source and SDK chunks before one fenced canonical Document+companion commit.
